project:
-- Build from Hackage releases at the index-state below, plus one Git pin; no
-- sibling checkouts required.
index-state: 2026-09-26T18:09:31Z
packages:
  mori-app

-- mori://shinzui/mori/packages/mori-types
-- Supplies Mori.Types.Webhook (RepositoryEvent, WebhookEventPayload,
-- parseEventData, verifySignature). Not published to Hackage, so it stays a pin.
source-repository-package
  type: git
  location: https://github.com/shinzui/mori
  tag: 32882f2d48bde6735d73cbd81c012c8d30ba11f3
  subdir:
    mori-types

-- Every dependency other than the mori-types pin above resolves from Hackage at
-- the index-state declared at the top of this file.
--
-- Six git pins were retired when mori-app stopped
-- depending on rei-core
-- (mori://shinzui/mori-rei-app/plans/24-reshape-the-mori-app-seam-so-the-consumer-owns-the-effect-stack):
--
--   rei-core            -- mori-app owns no domain effect stack; the consumer does
--   tan-commons         -- reached only through rei-core (Rei.Config.AppConfig)
--   tan-effectful       -- hasql-effectful; MoriApp.Idempotency now runs plain
--                          Hasql sessions on the pool, and rei-core vendored its
--                          own copy as Rei.Infrastructure.Hasql.Effect
--   typeid-hs           -- reached only through rei-core
--   hasql-migration     -- reached only through typeid-hs's deprecated backend
--   hasql-notifications -- no .cabal file named it and no module imported it
--
-- pg-migrate-import-hasql-migration is a DIFFERENT, Hackage package that reads a
-- legacy hasql-migration ledger during the pgmq history import in MoriApp.Env.
-- It stays. See mori://shinzui/rei/okf/adrs/concepts/ADR-11.
--
-- The constraints and allow-newer blocks went with them. Every entry in both
-- existed to reconcile a bound inside rei-core's closure -- crypton 1.1 for the
-- hasql-migration fork's MD5 path, http-client-tls 0.4 for the cohort that
-- forced, and package-qualified lifts for proto-lens, fuzzyfind, link-canonical,
-- claude, kiroku-cli, haxl and hasql-effectful. None of those packages is in the
-- solved plan any more, and the plan solves with both blocks absent, which is
-- the evidence that they are dead rather than merely unused
-- (mori://shinzui/rei/okf/adrs/concepts/ADR-16: an entry that does not change the
-- solved plan is deleted, not documented). crypton is still in the closure at
-- 1.1.5, chosen without being asked. The `package blake3` and
-- `package hasql-dynamic-statements` stanzas went too: neither package is in the
-- plan, so both configured nothing.
--
-- scripts/dependency-closure-audit.sh fails if any of them comes back.
package pgmq-effectful
  tests: False

with-compiler: ghc-9.12.4
test-show-details: direct
tests: True

-- RTS tuning for faster GHC compilation
-- -A128m: larger allocation area reduces GC frequency
-- -qg: disable parallel GC (single-threaded GC is faster for compilation workloads)
-- -n4m: larger nursery chunk size
program-options
  ghc-options:
    +RTS
    -A128m
    -qg
    -n4m
    -RTS

-- Parallel module compilation
jobs: $ncpus
